item.title: New in Arize AX: OpenInference, TypeScript 2.0, Session Annotations, Integrations Revamp
item.description:
Date: December 04, 2025
Tags: ["Software Updates", "OpenInference", "TypeScript", "Telemetry", "Software Integrations"]
Summary:
  • Arize AX released multiple updates in November 2025.
  • OpenInference TypeScript 2.
  • 0 adds manual instrumentation features.
  • It supports function tracing and decorator-based method tracing.
  • Attribute helpers standardize OpenTelemetry metadata creation.
  • Integrations have been revamped for better performance.
